title: The Tabernacle Curtains and Frames

questions.question: What material were the inner curtains of the tabernacle made of?
options: Fine twined linen with blue, purple, and scarlet yarns
questions.correctAnswer: Fine twined linen with blue, purple, and scarlet yarns
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:1 (ESV): "You shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns."

questions.question: What figures were woven into the inner curtains?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:1 (ESV): "With cherubim skillfully worked into them shall you make them."

questions.question: What separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:33 (ESV): "The veil shall separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy."

questions.question: What was the outer covering of the tabernacle made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:7 (ESV): "You shall also make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle."

questions.question: What wood were the tabernacle frames made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:15 (ESV): "You shall make upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood."

questions.question: How many inner curtains were there?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:1 (ESV): "You shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains."

questions.question: How were the curtain sets joined together?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:6 (ESV): "And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to the other with the clasps."

questions.question: What were the bases (sockets) of the frames made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:19 (ESV): "And you shall make forty bases of silver under the twenty frames."

questions.question: How many goat-hair curtains were there?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:7 (ESV): "You shall make eleven curtains altogether."

questions.question: What was the outermost covering over the goats' hair?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:14 (ESV): "And you shall make for the tent a covering of tanned rams' skins and a covering of goatskins on top."

questions.question: How many frames were on the south side of the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:18 (ESV): "You shall make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle."

questions.question: What held the frames together horizontally?
options: Bars of acacia wood overlaid with gold
questions.correctAnswer: Bars of acacia wood overlaid with gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:26,29 (ESV): "You shall make bars of acacia wood... you shall overlay the bars with gold."

questions.question: How many pillars supported the veil?
options: Four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold
questions.correctAnswer: Four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:32 (ESV): "You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold."

questions.question: What went behind the veil in the Most Holy Place?
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:33 (ESV): "And you shall bring in there, inside the veil, the ark of the testimony."

questions.question: How many pillars held the screen at the entrance of the tent?
options: Five pillars of acacia overlaid with gold
questions.correctAnswer: Five pillars of acacia overlaid with gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:37 (ESV): "You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold."

key_verse_text: And the veil shall separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy.
